_comment: bearer-secret -> {name, products[, kind]}. An agent presents 'Authorization: Bearer <secret>' to the decision API; the token authenticates the caller AND names it (created_by/decided_by audit) and scopes it. products: ['*'] = all. Agents can create/consume/comment/read, NEVER decide. Optional "kind": "system" marks a PLATFORM job's token (the capture pollers) and grants the system role, which adds signal_customer — give it only to our own launchd jobs, never to a coding agent's token; any other kind value resolves as a plain agent. Gitignored — real secrets; never commit or paste into a PR body.
